results.fact: Parking pass at the Putvin trailhead
results.evidence: The pass dispute is between access.fees (Northwest Forest Pass required) and bivy[0].permit (no pass needed); bivy is owned by the camping clean-up so no patch is written. Research is split: the Forest Service trailhead listing (and a page copying it) says a pass or passport is needed at the trailhead, while a hiking-association page lists no parking pass, so access.fees is left as is. The Lake of the Angels bivy entry does serve this route; the Hamma Hamma road campgrounds are staging only.

results.correct_value: Reverse the route down the west slope to the Obstruction Point Road pullout
results.evidence: descent_text described Cathedral Peak (Amphitheatre, Upper Cathedral Lake camp). Steeple Rock is a 200-ft spire right beside Obstruction Point Road; the route itself goes from the road up west-slope scree and heather to the north-ridge notch, so the descent reverses it, as `descent`, approach and waypoints already say. descent_text is rewritten to match.
